title: Village Errands
subtitle: Small jobs for the people you meet

quests.title: A Farmer's Request

lines: Oh, a traveller! The crows got half my wheat this year.
Could you bring me a stack of wheat? I'll make it worth your while.

text: The farmer lost half the harvest. Bring 64 wheat.

quests.title: The Lost Letter

lines: The ink has run, but you can make out a few lines:
"...if this reaches anyone, tell the cleric in the nearest village that I kept my promise..."

text: A zombie was carrying a letter meant for a village cleric. Find a cleric and give them the news.

lines: A letter? Let me see... Oh. Oh, thank you.
He kept his promise after all. Here, take this, and may the light keep you.
